name: Cheesy Homemade Black Bean Burger with Avocado, Tomato & Tater Tots (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed. NOTE: recipe will make four black bean burger patties but only uses three. Enjoy the extra burger patty in another meal!

Drain and rinse beans. Transfer to a baking sheet pan, pat dry with paper towels, and spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until beans are slightly dried out, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 green bell pepper
1 tomato
1 avocado
¼ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Peel, halve, and small dice onion. Place both in a small bowl.

Preheat a skillet over medium heat. Once hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Transfer bell pepper mixture to a food processor along with bread crumbs, cheese, egg, and taco seasoning. Pulse until mostly smooth and combined, 6-8 pulses.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup panko bread crumbs
½ cup cheddar cheese, shredded
1 egg
2 tsp taco seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Add oven-dried beans to the food processor and pulse to combine (leaving some larger pieces of bean), 3-4 pulses. Form bean mixture into four ½-inch thick patties. Wipe the baking sheet clean with a paper towel, coat with a thin layer of oil, then arrange patties in a single layer. Set aside.
Change oven to 475°F. Line another baking sheet with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).

Transfer tater tots to the foil-lined baking sheet, sprinkle with taco seasoning (leaving 1 cup unseasoned for sensitive palates), and stir to coat; spread out in an even layer. Place in the oven and bake, stirring once, until golden brown and crispy, about 20 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (32 oz) bag tater tots or puffs, frozen
2 tsp taco seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Add black bean burgers to the oven and bake, flipping halfway, until cooked through, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve tomato lengthwise, then cut into ½-inch thick wedges. Place on a plate.

Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh. Cut half of the avocado lengthwise into wedges. Slice remaining avocado crosswise into thin half-moons. Add both to the plate with the tomato and set aside.
Pick cilantro leaves off the stems. Discard the stems and set leaves aside.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide 1 cup of tater tots, tomato, and avocado wedges between plates. Cut one burger patty into pieces and add half to each of the plates. Serve with ketchup for dipping. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Place the bottom half of the buns on plates, top each with a burger patty, cilantro leaves, avocado slices, and salsa, then close with the top half of the buns. Serve with remaining tater tots and enjoy! (Save the extra burger patty for another meal!)
